evidence.observed_facts: Group page states 1,061 members, Montréal QC CA. Bilingual About (English then French): 'WiMLDS Montreal's events cover topics related to machine learning and data science, in a multidisciplinary and inclusive way... We use an inclusive definition of "woman"... Everyone is welcome to the events.' Last listed past events: '[Online] WIMLDS Montreal #7: AI in the Video Game Industry' on 2020-11-26 (55 attendees); '[Online] WIMLDS Montreal #6: AI in Health' on 2020-11-12 (41); 'Women's Data Day' on 2020-09-12 (23); in-person 'WIMLDS Montreal #5: AI for Good' on 2019-11-14 at 6650 Rue Saint-Urbain (87). No event within the 12 months before accessed_on.
evidence.inference: WiMLDS Montreal is a standing women-in-ML/data community chapter with no recent activity; retained as dormant historical/contextual context.

uncertainty_notes: Dormant (no event within 12 months). Slack link and social channels on the group page are not recorded as contact routes; contact_info null.

typical_venue: Maison Notman House, 51 Sherbrooke Ouest (historical in-person venue, 2019 events)
verification_questions: Confirm whether Ethereum Blockchain Montreal has resumed events (About states 'at least once a month' but the last listed event was May 2020; the ethmontreal.com companion site is a static historical page).

evidence.observed_facts: Group page states 885 members, Montréal QC CA. About: 'The Ethereum Blockchain Dev meetup group aims to help build a strong collaborative community of developers and entrepreneurs in Montreal... At least once a month we'll hold an event with speakers, demos, updates, and coding projects.' Last listed past events: 'Maker Dao Vision and Stable Coins' on 2020-05-28 (online, 38 attendees); 'Ethereum Montreal - DEX and Collectible Card Game' on 2019-06-06 at Maison Notman House, 51 Sherbrooke Ouest (47); 'Ethereum Montreal: Local project Demo - BRD...' on 2019-03-25 (51); 'Constantinople Hard Fork Explanation' on 2019-01-29 (57). Companion site ethmontreal.com is a static page directing to Meetup. No event within the 12 months before accessed_on.
evidence.inference: Ethereum Blockchain Montreal is a standing historical Ethereum/web3 community with no listed activity since 2020; retained as dormant contextual signal for the web3 category.

uncertainty_notes: Dormant. ethmontreal.com companion site is static/historical and is not recorded as a contact route (no live event feed). No public co-host invitation language on the group page.
